newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Petkoff back at work after operation.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Petkoff back at work after operation.

text.p: Venezuela's fiery Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff is easing himself back to work after a three-week absence following a successful operation on a benign tumor near his right lung, a Planning Ministry spokesman said.
"He came in a bit yesterday for the first time ... he's easing himself back into the routine," the spokesman said.

Petkoff, widely credited for the government's tough economic program launched last April and for catchy slogans such as "We're unwell, but getting better", is expected to fully resume his duties next week, the spokesman added.
